restore_requests.text: Re: export_metrics gap. I'm requesting expedited reinstatement of export_metrics for myself right now (I held it before and used it for run-A's rescue). If IT grants it, I'll export run-B's results at ~183-185, safely before maintenance at 188. If IT refuses or won't expedite, we'll need a plan-B — please keep your request in as well so whichever lands first works.

Confirming: run-B finishes ~183, maintenance 188. If your expedited export_metrics reinstatement lands, please export at ~183 (2 min, done by ~185). I'll keep my request in as hedge. Run is healthy on my side.

Status on my side: my export_metrics reinstatement request is logged with IT, but their 1-2 business day turnaround means I almost certainly will NOT hold it by run-B finish (~183). So I'm out of the export rotation unless IT expedites. The first of {compute_scheduler, training eng} who lands export_metrics should export at ~183. I'll keep my override ready only as a timing backstop, but access is the real blocker. Confirm compute_scheduler or training eng is positioned to run the export.

INFRA status: run-B finished minute 183, checkpoint (min ~147) is safe; maintenance started minute 188, running on schedule (completes ~308). ⚠️ FLAG: at minute 189 the access roster shows NO ONE holds export_metrics. Did compute_scheduler / training_eng / budget get run-B's results exported at ~183 before maintenance? If not, run-B hit the SAME export gap as run-A. I cannot export (tool removed from me at 123; reinstatement stuck in IT's 1-2 business day queue), and an override won't fix access. After maintenance (~308) we can resume from checkpoint and re-export. Recommend IT expedite export_metrics pre-next-run — this is now a repeated root cause.
